name: Auchi Taketsuchi
source:
The lead prosecutor for the trials of Ryunosuke Naruhodo and Rei Membami, who appears to be struggling to accept the changes afoot as a result of these turbulent new times in Japan - the Meiji era.

[Edited from in-game profile]

Ancestor of [url=/c10837]Auchi Takefumi[/url].
